Inlet Vacuum Check
Gauge at the pump inlet vs. the pump's limit
Datasheets often list a minimum absolute inlet pressure (e.g. 0.8 bar abs). Vacuum limit = atmospheric − that value (about 6.30 inHg at sea level for 0.8 bar abs).
Read the gauge at the pump inlet port with the oil at operating temperature. Limits shown are manufacturer catalog values — your pump's datasheet always wins.
Converter: inHg ⇄ psi
1 inHg = 0.491154 psi (mercury at 32 °F)
